study scan.description: Lists the series in files and folders: pseudonymised id, format, modality, size, description.

items.description: a DICOM folder or file, or a NIfTI file

study open.description: Opens a series into a workspace (created if needed; the source files are hashed) and describes it.

workspace.description: workspace directory; relative paths go below the operator's workspace root

series.description: series from study scan, when the source holds several

study info.description: Describes the open study: size, spacing, patient geometry, value unit, window presets, annotation and segment counts.

view slice.description: Renders one slice to a PNG with a sidecar mapping pixels to voxels and patient mm. Look with images; take numbers from probe, stats and measure.

workspace.description: workspace directory; relative paths go below the operator's workspace root

at.description: the slice through this point (instead of slice_number)

voxel.description: 0-based voxel (i, j, k) of the canonical LPS grid; integers are voxel centres

pixel.description: pixel (x, y) of that render; pixel centres lie at +0.5

window.description: window preset or explicit window (default: the series' own)

size.description: largest image side in pixels (capped by the operator)

view montage.description: Renders several slices of one plane as a labelled grid (PNG + sidecar with a mapping per tile). Use it to find where something is, then view slice for detail.

workspace.description: workspace directory; relative paths go below the operator's workspace root

step.description: every n-th slice (default: at most 16 tiles)

window.description: window preset or explicit window (default: the series' own)

size.description: largest image side in pixels (capped by the operator)

view mpr.description: Renders axial, coronal and sagittal slices through a point side by side, with a crosshair at the point (PNG + sidecar with a mapping per tile).

segment interactive.description: Prompts an interactive engine (points, boxes, scribbles, lassos). A new object becomes a segment proposed by the engine; segment refines an object made earlier (append adds to its stored prompts, undo drops the last); from_segment redoes a segment you made, seeded with lassos from its mask. Only a region around the prompts is uploaded. The result carries quality checks.

segment shape.description: Shape of a segment from its voxels: volume, extent in mm, slice ranges and largest slices, axial long and short axis with end points, border contact, components and, for segments named left or right, the side it lies on. Measure segments with this, never from images.

segment components.description: Connected components (26-connected) of a segment, largest first, with centroid, box and volume. With split, every further component of at least min_ml becomes a new segment; the largest stays.

split.description: make segments of the components (only segments you created or asked an engine for)

segment compare.description: Agreement of two segments: Dice, Jaccard, volumes and their difference, HD95 and Hausdorff distance in mm, centroid distance. b may be in another workspace of the same series (b_workspace).

segment edit.description: Deterministic clean-up of a segment you created or asked an engine for: keep_largest (largest component), fill_holes (enclosed background), restrict_to_box, remove_small (components below min_ml).
